snippet.title: Little Nightmares III | The Carnevale | 10-minute Gameplay Walkthrough
snippet.description:
From the creaking carousel to the flickering lights—and the many disturbing faces—you're in for a ride.

Watch this 10-minute gameplay walkthrough of the Carnevale and brace yourselves, little ones. #LittleNightmares
